reviews.body:
Thanks for addressing token reporting for interrupted pydantic-ai runs. I have one recommended test addition; it isn't a merge blocker.

1 approved findings: 1 inline, 0 in this review body.

<!-- conductor-review:v2: -->

review_comments.body:
RECOMMENDED: The updated test covers normal completion and checks the usage dictionary, but it never exercises this partial-output mapping. Reverting these lookups to the old keys would leave that test passing while interrupted `AgentOutput` instances report `None` for their token counts. The existing interruption test checks only content and partial status.

Please extend `test_execute_with_interrupt_returns_partial_output` in `tests/test_providers/test_pydantic_ai_provider.py` with deterministic, unequal input and output counts. Keep `run_with_interrupt` real, and assert that `AgentOutput.input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, and `tokens_used` match those counts and their sum.
